record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: Does the ambient cosmological construction remain valid for all perturbations of Minkowski space that are conformally related to the original metric, so that the construction can be regarded as stable under arbitrary conformally related perturbations?

evidence.quote: If, for instance, we are interested in the global stability of the Minkowski space, and consider some perturbation of it, then what we have shown here implies that we may replace it with any other, conformally related perturbation of it without disturbing the ambient construction.
Therefore it seems that our construction is admitted by all conformally related perturbations of Minkowski space. This is something left to future work.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\mathbb{R}^{1,n}, \eta)$ denote Minkowski space with the standard flat Lorentzian metric $\eta$. The Fefferman–Graham ambient construction associates to a conformal class $[g]$ on an $n$-dimensional manifold $M$ an ambient Lorentzian metric on a neighbourhood of $M \times \{0\} \times \mathbb{R}_+$ inside an $(n+2)$-dimensional manifold, in such a way that the cone bundle over $M$ embeds as a hypersurface in the ambient space and the ambient metric restricts to a representative of $[g]$. When $g = \eta$ is flat Minkowski space, this construction reproduces the standard ambient (light-cone) realisation.

Now consider an arbitrary smooth perturbation $\tilde{g}$ of $\eta$, and let $[\tilde{g}]$ denote its conformal class, i.e. the family of metrics $\{\Omega^2 \tilde{g} : \Omega \in C^\infty(\mathbb{R}^{1,n}), \Omega > 0\}$.

Question: Does the ambient cosmological construction extend to every metric in the conformal class $[\tilde{g}]$ of every perturbation $\tilde{g}$ of $\eta$? Equivalently, is the ambient construction stable in the sense that whenever it applies to a perturbation $\tilde{g}$ of Minkowski space, it applies to every metric conformally related to $\tilde{g}$, so that the global stability of Minkowski space in this framework is preserved under arbitrary conformally related perturbations?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface any work establishing or refuting the claim that the ambient cosmological construction is admitted by all conformally related perturbations of Minkowski space. The construction is described as plausibly stable under such perturbations, but a proof appears to be left for future work, and no follow-up resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Ambient construction - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The model flat geometry for the ambient construction is the future null cone in Minkowski space, with the origin deleted; the celestial sphere at infinity is the conformal manifold M.
status_evidence.claim: Background on the Fefferman–Graham ambient construction, without addressing conformal-perturbation stability of Minkowski.

status_evidence.title: Cosmology in Minkowski space (arXiv:2306.16868)
status_evidence.snippet: Conformal transformations are employed to cast cosmology into static and Minkowski space for smooth backgrounds and for scalar and tensor perturbations.
status_evidence.claim: Related discussions of conformal transformations and cosmological perturbations, but no resolution of the specific stability question.
